title: justicia wasshausenii
intro: Justicia wasshausenii, commonly known as the Water-willow, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
